title: feat(fields): a file the reader may not open renders a restricted state (objectui#12339)
body:
Fixes #12339
Clause-②: yes

## What changed

The platform now sends a file the reader may not open as `{ id, metadataRefused: true }` (`FileRefusedValueSchema` in `@objectstack/spec/data`, objectstack#22593). Until now `readFileValue` read it through its ordinary object arm, so every renderer drew a generic chip named `File`. This PR makes the refusal visible.

- **`packages/fields/src/widgets/file-value.ts`**: `readFileValue` recognises the marker with the spec's own closed `FileRefusedValueSchema` (no hand-written second shape) and returns a view with `metadataRefused: true`, the id, the id-derived URL and no `mimeType`. `FileValueView` gains the optional `metadataRefused?: true`.
- **`packages/fields/src/widgets/file-refused.ts`** (new, not in the package barrel): `isFileRefusedValue` and `fileValueForResubmit`.
- **`packages/fields/src/widgets/file-affordance.tsx`**: `RestrictedFileAffordance` draws a lock and the translated "Restricted file" label, with the hint on `title`. It stays a link to the id-derived endpoint, which decides access on its own and may answer `403 FILE_DOWNLOAD_DENIED`. `FileValueAffordance` routes a restricted view to it, so every surface that already used the shared affordance picks it up.
- Renderers, each pinned on a real render:
  - `FileCellRenderer`, the `file` / `video` / `audio` grid cell: restricted link in place of the `File` chip.
  - `FileField`, read-only list and edit rows: restricted link, with a lock icon in place of the file icon or thumbnail.
  - `FileCell`, the line-item grid control: lock in the chip, with the tooltip and the remove button named by the restricted label.
  - `ImageField`, read-only and editable: a restricted lock tile in place of the thumbnail. It is left out of the lightbox and has no crop button.
  - `ImageCellRenderer`, the `image` / `avatar` grid cell: a compact restricted lock beside any drawable thumbnails. A value holding only refused images is no longer "No value".
  - `AvatarField`: a lock, named by the label, in place of the initials, and no image request.
- **Submitting.** `fileIdOf` already reads `id` from the marker. The remaining gap was that `FileField`, `FileCell` and `ImageField` re-submit the field's other values on append, remove and crop, and they passed those values back raw, so a marker could be sent as an object. They now go through `fileValueForResubmit`, which reduces the marker to its bare id and leaves every other element untouched.
- **i18n**: `fields.file.restricted` and `fields.file.restrictedHint` in all ten locales.
- **Docs**: `content/docs/fields/file.mdx` gains a "Restricted files" paragraph, and `image.mdx` points to it.

## Landing point

The card expected the change in `packages/fields/src/`, and every renderer it names lives there. The grid cells are `FileCellRenderer` and `ImageCellRenderer` in `packages/fields/src/index.tsx`, and `plugin-grid` resolves them through `getCellRenderer`. The one file outside that surface is `packages/i18n/src/locales/*`, for the two new keys the dispatch asked for.

## Clause-② measurement (public surface)

Measured on the built declaration closure, after building the `@object-ui/fields` dependency closure and then `@object-ui/fields`:

- `dist/index.d.ts` still re-exports `./widgets/file-value.js`. `dist/widgets/file-value.d.ts` now declares `metadataRefused?: true` on `FileValueView`. That is the widening: a new optional member on a published interface.
- `isFileRefusedValue`, `fileValueForResubmit`, `RestrictedFileAffordance` and `useRestrictedFileText` each have zero hits in `dist/index.d.ts`. `file-refused.d.ts` and `file-affordance.d.ts` are emitted, but no import chain from `dist/index.d.ts` reaches them.
- `@object-ui/i18n`: the exported locale packs gain two keys.

The changeset `.changeset/12339-file-restricted-state.md` is `minor` for both packages.

## Tests

New file: `packages/fields/src/__tests__/fileRestrictedState-12339.test.tsx`, 22 tests, all on real renders.

**Ablation.** The fix was committed first. Each mutation went through `ablation-replace` with an anchor that had to hit, the blob hash checked on disk, and a restore leg ending with `git diff HEAD` empty.

| Mutation | Result | Which tests failed |
| --- | --- | --- |
| None (fix in place) | 22 passed | none |
| Disable the marker arm in `readFileValue` | 14 failed, 8 passed | every render pin |
| `fileValueForResubmit` returns the value unchanged | 3 failed, 19 passed | the three re-submit pins |

The 8 that stayed green under the first mutation are the schema control, the "normal value unchanged" and "not the marker" controls, and the three re-submit pins.

Gates run on this branch. The code has not changed since the gates ran, and the HEAD they ran on is named in the os-dev-report comment on the card.

| Gate | Result |
| --- | --- |
| `pnpm --filter @object-ui/fields type-check` | exit 0 |
| `pnpm --filter @object-ui/i18n type-check` | exit 0 |
| `vitest run`, 28 file/image/avatar/cell/upload/spec-symbol test files in `packages/fields` | 455 passed |
| `vitest run packages/i18n/` | 1321 passed, 13 skipped |
| `check:` phantom-deps, self-import, unreferenced-sources, doc-example-readers, handler-key-reads, side-effects-array, element-data-source-declaration, spec-symbols, action-forward-parity, designer-field-key-parity, icon-record-names, i18n-keys, i18n-drift, i18n-designer-parity, new-line-citations, i18n-dead-keys | all exit 0 |
| `node scripts/check-changeset-fixed.mjs`, `check-changeset-presence.mjs`, `check-changeset-no-major.mjs` | all exit 0 |
| `eslint --no-inline-config` on the touched files | 0 errors |

Not measured locally, so CI owns these:

- The full `packages/fields` suite. It did not fit in the foreground cap on a contended box.
- Repository-wide `pnpm lint`. The eslint config is not type-aware and the custom rules read only their own file, so this diff cannot change the verdict on an untouched file.

## Acceptance notes

These are noted here and not filed:

- `plugin-list` `ObjectGallery` takes a gallery cover from `readFileValues(raw)[0]?.url`. For a refused image that is the id-derived endpoint, so the gallery may request an image the door refuses. It can now check `metadataRefused`. This was not reproduced against a live server. Owner: none.
- A multiple-file append still passes an already-expanded `{ id, name, size, mimeType, url }` element back raw beside the new id. This predates this PR, and it is a read form at a stored position. This PR reduces only the refused marker, which is what the card asks for. Not measured against a strict server. Owner: none.
- The record header's `recordPictureUrl` in `@object-ui/components` gets no URL from the marker, because the marker carries no `url`. So the header draws no picture, where the image cell draws a restricted lock. That is not a broken image. The parity pin `file-value.recordChromeParity-11383` stays green because it has no marker fixture.
- `AvatarField` never offered an open link, so its restricted state is a lock with no link. The card's "open affordance stays" item applies where an affordance exists.
